_about: Narrative profile of every nemesis (keyed by wiki title, matching nemeses.title in the DB) plus friends/foes. signs = foreshadowing usable in a battle introduction; aftermath = what is left/learned after victory (good for treasure framing); hook = one-line premise. Game data (life, difficulty, expedition battles) lives in the nemeses table.

nemeses.title: Rageborne
nemeses.origin: The Nameless' champion, sent once Gravehold became a worthy foe; it killed breach commander Thraxir.
signs: bells and beggars crying 'The end is near!' in Chasmwalk
the cave walls quake as it bellows
nemeses.aftermath: A Core of Rage remembered in the archives.
nemeses.hook: The executioner of Gravehold returns to finish what it started.
nemeses.teaser: Something out there kills for the sake of killing, and it has been waiting for a worthy foe.

nemeses.title: Carapace Queen
nemeses.origin: Mother-of-Husks whose clockwork-like swarms have brought the most ruin upon Gravehold; destroyed before The Fall, but a Broodwomb survived.
signs: the claxon call of her legions
skittering loud enough to drown screams
husks twitching on the cave floor
nemeses.aftermath: Mountains of metallic husk scraps carried into The Depths; a carapace fragment of strange power.
nemeses.hook: 'To kill one is to breed six' — the husks are coming again.
nemeses.teaser: The scouts heard skittering that way: thousands of small legs, and one great heartbeat beneath them.

nemeses.title: Crooked Mask
nemeses.origin: The god of corruption through temptation; its laugh is heard under the bells. Its Corrupters spread madness through the weak.
signs: dust from a torn world that warps minds
whispers behind the eyes tempting mages into the abyss
a laugh under the bells and screams
nemeses.aftermath: Mages recover their wits but remember what they were offered.
nemeses.hook: Something is offering Gravehold's hungry exactly what they need.
nemeses.teaser: Those who went that way came back smiling, and talking about what they had been promised.

nemeses.title: Crooked Mask (Beyond the Breach)
nemeses.origin: Indira realises the Mask laughs because it was once human — a mage corrupted enough to go mad but not wholly monster.
nemeses.aftermath: The question: who was it, and did we love them?
nemeses.hook: Somewhere close, a laugh rings out — and it sounds almost familiar.
nemeses.teaser: Somewhere down that road, something is laughing.

nemeses.title: Prince of Gluttons
nemeses.origin: Fourth Nameless to besiege Gravehold; it devoured the city's history, even the name of the world, leaving only fear.
signs: blank pages in the archive books
nemeses.aftermath: Blank books; a Glutton's Tooth that makes you hungry.
nemeses.hook: The archive's records are vanishing word by word.
nemeses.teaser: The villagers that way cannot remember their own names.

nemeses.title: Horde-Crone
nemeses.origin: Stirred the trogg tribes (Yud, Orp, Zom) from their slumber in the deep to reclaim the city they built.
signs: night raids from the depths without a sound
nemeses.aftermath: The sleeping deity of the troggs remains somewhere below.
nemeses.hook: Gravehold's first builders want their home back — and they may have the right.
nemeses.teaser: Old things are waking in the deep that way, and they remember this land as theirs.

nemeses.title: Blight Lord
nemeses.origin: First Nameless to touch The World That Was; turned Karek and M'hlark to green glass.
signs: people frozen in green horror outside the walls
tainted jade that calls the weak
nemeses.aftermath: Breach glass that paves the dirt market; a pouch of noble gems lost beneath the walls.
nemeses.hook: Green crystal is creeping across the cave walls again.
nemeses.teaser: Everything that way is slowly turning to green glass.

nemeses.title: The Blight
nemeses.origin: The Blighted God in the age of the pilgrimage, guarding its crystal fields full of Raven's petrified family.
signs: the horizon obscured by its immensity
nemeses.aftermath: The path to safety — but it cannot truly be defeated.
nemeses.hook: The only road to safety passes through a field of crystal statues.
nemeses.teaser: The horizon that way glitters, and it is getting closer.

nemeses.title: Wayward One
nemeses.origin: Trapped neither here nor there, wailing; touching its dust fades you away. The mages fight it out of compassion.
signs: a flickering wail over the west wall
people shifting out of the world for hours
nemeses.hook: A tormented Nameless seeks an end to its struggle — give it one.
nemeses.teaser: A wailing drifts on the wind from that way, more grief than threat.

nemeses.title: The Wanderer
nemeses.origin: Kin of another wandering Nameless, identified in the archives by Brama and Mazra.
signs: a wavering, inconsistent form seen by scouts
nemeses.hook: Scouts describe something Brama has fought before — the archives must say what.
nemeses.teaser: Something that way flickers in and out of the world, like a half-remembered dream.

nemeses.title: Wayward Reflection
nemeses.origin: A creature in two places at once, trapped in the borderland of a breach.
signs: the same creature seen in two places
nemeses.aftermath: Nook wonders what other dimensions exist.
nemeses.hook: Two sightings, miles apart, of the same Nameless at the same moment.
nemeses.teaser: The scouts saw the same shape in two places at once.

nemeses.title: Gate Witch
nemeses.origin: The 'ragged face of the infinite' Yan Magda saw in the Void; bends and breaks time.
signs: a burnt-air smell before the bells
nemeses.hook: Time is running out — literally.
nemeses.teaser: Those who went that way came back older, or younger, than they left.

nemeses.title: Hollow Crown
nemeses.origin: Compels worship rather than fear; its masked acolytes were mages practising blood magic in the Craghollows.
signs: people kneeling in tears as it passes
an acolyte walking into the humming breach
nemeses.hook: Missing mages are seen kneeling in the ruins, masked.
nemeses.teaser: People walk that way on their own, their faces wet with tears of joy.

nemeses.title: Magus of Cloaks
nemeses.origin: A thing of darkness: every blow peels away one cloak of shadow to reveal another.
nemeses.aftermath: A shimmering cloak woven out of aether.
nemeses.hook: The torches of Gravehold go out one by one.
nemeses.teaser: On that road the torches go out, one by one.

nemeses.title: Thrice-Dead Prophet
nemeses.origin: Shambled from the void clad with the faces of forgotten gods; died three times as a feint; something was born from its corpse.
signs: a vast body covered with gods' faces
nemeses.aftermath: Something stirs inside its corpse — and Ulgimor is created.
nemeses.hook: It died. It's moving again.
nemeses.teaser: Something huge lies dead on that road. The scouts swear it moved.

nemeses.title: Twice-Dead Prophet
nemeses.origin: The Prophet as met by time-displaced Indira; its faces may be the statues of abandoned gods animated by grief.
nemeses.aftermath: A question: did the Prophet kill the gods?
nemeses.hook: A battle the chronicles describe differently than you remember.
nemeses.teaser: The chronicles describe what waits that way, but not the way you remember it.

nemeses.title: Umbra Titan
nemeses.origin: Born from the Prophet's neck; burrows beneath the cave's skin; cave beasts worship it. Its shadow created Ulgimor.
signs: the ground shakes before it strikes
nemeses.aftermath: A coal fragment of its shadow.
nemeses.hook: The floor trembles; nobody knows where to hide.
nemeses.teaser: Something vast moves beneath the stone that way, and the ground has learned to fear it.

nemeses.title: Wraithmonger
nemeses.origin: Not born of the void: a shapeless horror inside every dreamer, manifesting when they sleep.
signs: a flickering shape above the sleeping city
nemeses.hook: The camp cannot sleep: every dream feeds the thing above it.
nemeses.teaser: No one who camped that way has slept since.

nemeses.title: Knight of Shackles
nemeses.origin: The corrupted Thraxir, returned from The Depths commanding an army of the dead whose eyes are mage gems; knows Gravehold's defenses.
signs: the dead missing from The Depths
a rider on a blighted steed
nemeses.hook: The dead of Gravehold are marching — led by someone who knows the walls.
nemeses.teaser: The dead are walking that way, in ranks, like soldiers.

nemeses.title: Maiden of Thorns
nemeses.origin: Revels in cruelty and sups knowledge from mages' skulls.
nemeses.hook: A new mage returns from patrol not knowing who he is.
nemeses.teaser: The few who came back from that road no longer know who they are.

nemeses.title: Bladius
nemeses.origin: A bred-for-battle lieutenant of a greater Nameless, hunting survivors in the tunnels.
signs: growls echoing in the dark tunnels
nemeses.aftermath: A battle-scarred enemy who may return.
nemeses.hook: A lieutenant of something far worse ambushes survivors in the tunnels.
nemeses.teaser: Blades glint in the dark that way: a hunter bred for nothing but battle.

nemeses.title: Maelstrom
nemeses.origin: Drawn by Xaxos' experiment; colossal orb of spinning blades that destroyed Gravehold.
nemeses.hook: The breach above the city is growing.
nemeses.teaser: The sky that way is spinning.

nemeses.title: Maelstrom: Risen
nemeses.origin: Siphoned power beneath the rubble and rose from the sinkhole for revenge.
signs: a sound you have heard once before, the night Gravehold fell
nemeses.aftermath: Its blades piercing the earth like monuments; an Eye of the Maelstrom that 'gives back'.
nemeses.hook: Scouts at the sinkhole report the rubble is moving.
nemeses.teaser: Something buried long ago is digging its way back out.

nemeses.title: Spawning Horror
nemeses.origin: Has rested on the surface so long it became part of the world; spawns pods.
signs: a breeding ground under a torn sky
nemeses.aftermath: Pods that Malastar crafts into equipment.
nemeses.hook: A breeding ground of pods could arm the city — if its mother is killed.
nemeses.teaser: Pods are growing along that road, and something is tending them.

nemeses.title: Fungal Mesh
nemeses.origin: Spores that overtake minds, turning scouts against each other; it took Brama.
nemeses.hook: Brama walks out of the trees — and raises her hands to cast at you.
nemeses.teaser: Spores drift on the wind that way, and the scouts who breathed them turned on each other.

nemeses.title: Haze Fiend
nemeses.origin: A fog that appears and vanishes within an hour, draining camps of life; its natural camouflage.
signs: fog creeping from a hidden breach at night
nemeses.aftermath: The haze lifts; only the fallen remain.
nemeses.hook: Outlying camps are found dead in the morning after a fog.
nemeses.teaser: A fog lies over that road, and the camps inside it have gone silent.

nemeses.title: Deathmind
nemeses.origin: Guards a powerful ore; wipes the memories and reflexes of scouts.
nemeses.aftermath: The ore; the Bones of Deathmind.
nemeses.hook: The ore Malastar needs is guarded by something that eats minds.
nemeses.teaser: Scouts came back from there with empty eyes and no memories.

nemeses.title: Xaxos: Ascended
nemeses.origin: Xaxos amplified by the Void, wielding breaches as no living mage has.
signs: breaches opening in a circle around one figure
nemeses.aftermath: Xaxos taken by the void — or fled.
nemeses.hook: An old friend returns, and wants the breach to stay open.
nemeses.teaser: A familiar voice calls from that road, promising power.

nemeses.title: Necroswarm
nemeses.origin: A gentle plant Nameless far to the south that raised Inco; driven north by the traitor mage's glyphs to rot New Gravehold's crops.
nemeses.hook: The crops are dying — something old and once-kind is marching north.
nemeses.teaser: The plants are dying that way, and the rot is walking.

nemeses.title: The Wailing
nemeses.origin: A flying Nameless whose screams seed blue onyx in the veins of those who hear it.
signs: trees encased in blue onyx veined with darkness
nemeses.aftermath: Onyx statues, like the jade victims of an older Nameless.
nemeses.hook: Forest scouts come back with stiffening joints and blue under their skin.
nemeses.teaser: A scream carries from that way, and the trees there have turned to stone.

nemeses.title: Maggoth
nemeses.origin: A Broodwomb that survived its mother's destruction, nursed by Arachnos into a giant insectoid.
nemeses.hook: The exiles in the woods have a pet — and they've let it loose near the city.
nemeses.teaser: Something big is crashing through the brush that way, and someone is following it, taking notes.

nemeses.title: Arachnos
nemeses.origin: Xaxos' student fused with a Void spider, torturing Soskel with void energy.
signs: a massive twisted breach with a kneeling figure
a man bound in webs inside the portal
nemeses.hook: The missing commander is being 'improved' inside a breach.
nemeses.teaser: Webs as thick as ropes cross that road, and a breach hums behind them.

nemeses.title: Ageless Walker
nemeses.origin: Karak, aged to bones and beyond by Arachnos' ritual; ages everything it walks past.
signs: piles of yellowed bones in cloaks
nemeses.hook: A teammate is found alive — but eighty years older.
nemeses.teaser: Leaves wither as you look down that road, and the scouts' hair has gone grey.

nemeses.title: Fenrix
nemeses.origin: A captured wolf fed Void essence by Arachnos; six glowing eyes, a howl that brings blizzards.
nemeses.hook: Snow in summer, and paw prints as wide as an arm.
nemeses.teaser: Snow is falling that way, though it is summer. And something howls.

nemeses.title: Experiment 153
nemeses.origin: Arachnos' rabbit, accidentally sealed in the Void for months.
signs: journal pages about a lost subject
nemeses.hook: An exile's journal mentions a subject he abandoned. It's still out there.
nemeses.teaser: Something small and broken is loose that way, and it has grown.

nemeses.title: Fountain of Souls
nemeses.origin: A living pool in the Void that subsumes aether crossing the breaches; its bubbles are almost recognisable.
nemeses.aftermath: Reborn friends — Dezmodia, Arachnos — and Thraxir's mind.
nemeses.hook: An old exile asks for help in the Void: something is drinking the souls of the dead.
nemeses.teaser: That road leads into the Void, toward a light that drinks the dead.

nemeses.title: Thief of Dreams
nemeses.origin: A hole in reality in the Void's sky that clouds the mind.
signs: even the stars cannot be trusted
nemeses.aftermath: A memento from 'a free trip to the Void'.
nemeses.hook: In the Void, the sky itself attacks.
nemeses.teaser: That road leads into the Void, where even the sky is hungry.

nemeses.title: Risen Thrall
nemeses.origin: A follower of an older Nameless that grew powerful in the Void and leads its own army.
nemeses.hook: A minion you once killed has its own army now.
nemeses.teaser: An army of bones marches that way, led by one of its own.

nemeses.title: The Burning Kor
nemeses.origin: A man of flame driven south by New Gravehold's expansion into Azer's forests.
signs: the forest burning around a walking man
nemeses.aftermath: Azer saved, resentment of New Gravehold.
nemeses.hook: Azer asks for help: a burning man is walking toward the village.
nemeses.teaser: The forest is burning that way, and the fire walks like a man.

nemeses.title: Fortress
nemeses.origin: An aquatic Nameless using the rubble of Gravehold's homes as a shell.
signs: wreckage that rises from the chasm floor
nemeses.aftermath: Insight into how Nameless adapt to our world.
nemeses.hook: The ruins of home stand up and attack.
nemeses.teaser: The ruins that way are standing up.

nemeses.title: Burrower
nemeses.origin: Glides through rock like water, leaving quicksand pitfalls.
nemeses.hook: Tunnels that were solid yesterday collapse today.
nemeses.teaser: The ground that way turns to quicksand without warning.

nemeses.title: Bishop of Scrolls
nemeses.origin: A Void-wanderer who tells Gravehold's history as a fairy tale and collects Nameless for an army.
signs: a voice asking 'Shall I tell you a story?'
nemeses.hook: Somewhere, someone is telling your story — and already knows how it ends.
nemeses.teaser: A voice drifts from that road, telling a story you almost recognise.

nemeses.title: Bishop: Returned
nemeses.origin: The Bishop's second tale: New Gravehold's walls, its excised dissidents, the inevitable new Fall.
signs: stories that predict the next disaster
nemeses.hook: The storyteller is back, with the next chapter of your story.
nemeses.teaser: The storyteller's voice is back, and its story has a new chapter.

nemeses.title: Fate Shepherd
nemeses.origin: An inquisitive Nameless that turns relics and gems against their users.
nemeses.hook: Your own relics grow restless in your hands, as if something were calling them.
nemeses.teaser: Mages who went that way say their own relics turned against them.

nemeses.title: Griefweaver
nemeses.origin: Towers taller than New Gravehold's walls with a lust for gems; perhaps reconstituted from a fallen mage.
signs: fingertips cresting the horizon against a purple sky
nemeses.aftermath: The thought it may have been a comrade.
nemeses.hook: A giant that craves the gems a dead friend once carried.
nemeses.teaser: Something taller than the city walls walks that way, searching for gems.

nemeses.title: Mother of Rust
nemeses.origin: Tiny Void scuttlers sharing one mind; together they take the shape of a woman.
signs: things pouring from cracks in stones
nemeses.aftermath: A single fragment that should not be spared.
nemeses.hook: The swarm stands up — and looks like someone you know.
nemeses.teaser: A tide of tiny metal things pours across that road.

nemeses.title: Rust Amalgam
nemeses.origin: A surviving fragment of an older swarm, pumped full of Void energy by a masked follower of Z'hana.
nemeses.hook: Someone fed a harmless fragment until it grew big as a house.
nemeses.teaser: Something metal and as big as a house is foaming at the mouth that way.

nemeses.title: Rust Superion
nemeses.origin: Created when Ilya's aether mixed with Void essence; Azer blames 'your city's wild Void mage'.
nemeses.aftermath: Blame between Azer and New Gravehold.
nemeses.hook: A harmless glyph ritual created a monster — and everyone blames someone else.
nemeses.teaser: A glyph ritual went wrong that way, and something came of it.

nemeses.title: Paradox of Bone
nemeses.origin: The purest distillation of the Void: rage fleeing pain that never eases.
nemeses.hook: A beast tramples everything because it is in agony.
nemeses.teaser: Something in agony is trampling everything that way.

nemeses.title: Paradox of Myth
nemeses.origin: A chained mask that drains and heals victims, puppeting Tethered mages against their friends.
signs: Tethered mages holding hands with glowing tattoos, dangling like puppets
nemeses.hook: Missing Azerian Tethers return — on chains.
nemeses.teaser: Golden chains have been seen that way, and the mages they hold.

nemeses.title: Paradox of Myth and Bone
nemeses.origin: The mask's trap caught the beast Bone; together raw strength and control.
nemeses.hook: Something has put a leash on the biggest beast in the Void.
nemeses.teaser: Chains and bone: something has put a leash on a giant.

nemeses.title: Mist Revealed
nemeses.origin: Mist herself, with the full force of Void magic, engineering a Second Fall to unite humanity.
signs: a figure raising her arms to the swirling dark
nemeses.hook: The mentor everyone trusts is the one opening the portals.
nemeses.teaser: Every portal points that way, and someone you trust is waiting at the centre.

nemeses.title: Brama (Legacy of Gravehold)
nemeses.origin: Brama as an enemy of the Void-mages: she will not watch what she built crumble.
nemeses.hook: The city's founder stands between you and your friends.
nemeses.teaser: The founder of the city waits that way, and she will not step aside.

nemeses.title: Z'hana (Legacy of Gravehold)
nemeses.origin: Z'hana as an enemy of New Gravehold: a haven for everyone, dangerous or not.
nemeses.hook: The traitor mage offers a better world. You must stop her.
nemeses.teaser: The traitor mage waits that way, with a better world to offer.

nemeses.title: Erythiza, Consumed
nemeses.origin: The great city of scientists, its people turned Nameless in an instant.
signs: a city where a city should not be
nemeses.aftermath: Questions about the heroes who contained it.
nemeses.hook: The lost city has been found — and it's hungry.
nemeses.teaser: A city stands that way where no city should be.

nemeses.title: Infested Mutation
nemeses.origin: Plants, animals and stones twisted by the calamity.
nemeses.hook: The forest itself has turned predator.
nemeses.teaser: Even the plants that way have turned predator.

nemeses.title: Stonemonger
nemeses.origin: Born of the invisible eruption; 'blood like rubies, teeth like pearls'.
nemeses.hook: The elders refuse to talk about what happened in the market.
nemeses.teaser: The survivors who came from that way will not talk about what they saw.

nemeses.title: Oracle of Filth
nemeses.origin: The Hunger fused with a boy in the Royal Erythiza Academy's laboratory.
signs: a scientist reluctant to destroy her specimen
nemeses.hook: A lab accident in Erythiza could end the world.
nemeses.teaser: That way lies a laboratory, and something in it is breathing.

nemeses.title: The Changeling Nest
nemeses.origin: Glowing cocoons in a Void swamp holding stolen children; branches become antlers.
nemeses.hook: A cocoon in the Void holds a human silhouette.
nemeses.teaser: Warm cocoons glow in a swamp that way, with shapes inside them.

nemeses.title: Herald of the End
nemeses.origin: Five dragon-like creatures bonded as one in the Void.
signs: razor tails and spiked muzzles intertwined
nemeses.aftermath: Xaxos asks which side is the real monster.
nemeses.hook: Five dragons, one will.
nemeses.teaser: Five shadows circle together over that road, never apart.

nemeses.title: Corruption's Core
nemeses.origin: The heart of Void essence observed by Xaxos in exile.
nemeses.hook: The source of corruption itself has a body.
nemeses.teaser: That way the corruption is so thick that skin begins to harden.

nemeses.title: The Reliquary
nemeses.origin: A human-looking Nameless in the Void that rips open portals and pulls monsters through — as Xaxos once did.
signs: portals opening from the Void side
nemeses.aftermath: Xaxos fears he walks in spirals.
nemeses.hook: Someone on the other side is opening the portals.
nemeses.teaser: Someone on the other side is opening portals that way.

nemeses.title: The Timeless
nemeses.origin: An ancient-but-too-young creature screaming with the pain of warped time.
nemeses.hook: Everyone who enters the woods comes out older.
nemeses.teaser: Those who go into the woods that way come out older.

nemeses.title: The Endless Decay
nemeses.origin: A corrupted animal that evaded the phoenixes long enough to become a Nameless; feeds on time.
nemeses.hook: Even the phoenixes are afraid.
nemeses.teaser: Predator and prey are fleeing that way, side by side.

nemeses.title: The Coven
nemeses.origin: What became of the women of Donnyton who tried to build something permanent.
nemeses.aftermath: A chunk of the Coven kept for the next fight.
nemeses.hook: The town that took you in years ago is not what it was.
nemeses.teaser: A town lies that way that once took travellers in. Its doors are shut now.

nemeses.title: The Infecter
nemeses.origin: Less a creature than a place: earth softening to mud, swollen staggering heralds.
nemeses.aftermath: A core destroyed before the miasma fills the lungs.
nemeses.hook: The road becomes a swamp — and the swamp is alive.
nemeses.teaser: The road that way sinks into a swamp that seems to breathe.

nemeses.title: The Wrath
nemeses.origin: Red-scaled guardian coiled over Gravehold at the pilgrimage's end.
signs: a red sun painting the city rose
nemeses.hook: The promised city is guarded.
nemeses.teaser: That way, beneath a red sun, something guards the city.

nemeses.title: Absorbing Wraith
nemeses.origin: A heatless beast in frozen caverns, Quilius' destined quarry.
signs: icy trails descending into the dark
nemeses.hook: Follow the frost into the blackest black.
nemeses.teaser: The trail that way is frozen, and the cold follows you.

nemeses.title: Rampaging Vin
nemeses.origin: Charges head-on through narrow caves; Tressa fights it for her son.
nemeses.hook: A treasure hunter's stash is the only weapon left.
nemeses.teaser: Something charges through the narrow caves that way, head down.

nemeses.title: Clouded Mesmer
nemeses.origin: Smoke that makes you need things and understands how magic works.
nemeses.hook: A sweet smoke drifts over the path, and with it come strange new wants.
nemeses.teaser: A smoke lies over that road that makes you want things.

nemeses.title: The Terror in Brass
nemeses.origin: Swims through Cindercrown's 'indestructible' iron like water.
nemeses.aftermath: Proof that walls are not enough.
nemeses.hook: The city's walls are the monster's ocean.
nemeses.teaser: The iron walls that way have been torn open from the inside.

nemeses.title: Kusiciele Okazji
nemeses.origin: Noble gems lost by an ancient Nameless, awakened by a forgotten spell; shrill cries of 'Buy! Buy! Buy!'. Regional promo.
signs: a pleasant glow in a side cave
nemeses.aftermath: Garu meditating in the Dew Garden for weeks.
nemeses.hook: Mages vanish chasing a lovely glow.
nemeses.teaser: Something glitters that way, and the mages who chased it never came back.

nemeses.title: Szalony Kotokronikarz
nemeses.origin: The Mad Cat Chronicler of Gravehold's archives, possessed by a Nameless trapped in a book. Regional promo.
nemeses.hook: The archive's books are marching.
nemeses.teaser: The archive's books are marching that way.

friends.title: Adelheim, the Blacksmith
friends.note: Forges and recycles 0-cost cards; a smith keeping the clan armed.

foes.title: The Cultist
foes.note: A human keeper of the abandoned city, corrupted.

foes.title: The Corrosion
foes.note: Hollow thing that only knows how to consume.

foes.title: The Scavenger
foes.note: Finishes off the half-dead after battle.

foes.title: The Swarm
foes.note: Small Void critters that multiply underground.

foes.title: Jeweled Wrath
foes.note: A jewel-encrusted monster posing as treasure.

foes.title: The Traitor
foes.note: A mage who believes only they can protect everyone ('I'll save them all').

foes.title: The Mask
foes.note: A familiar-feeling thing from Qu's childhood.

foes.title: Creeping Dark
foes.note: Brings darkness to hide something that must be seen.

foes.title: The Anomaly
foes.note: Time snapping in on itself after Nook's experiments.
